'''Rupings''' were reptavians native to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Onderon/Legends|Onderon]]. The [[Onderon rebels/Legends|Onderon rebels]] used rupings as battle mounts during the [[Battle of Onderon/Legends|Battle of Onderon]].<ref name="AWoTF">{{TCW|A War on Two Fronts}}</ref>

==Personality and traits==
[[File:Dangerous_Sorties_SoT.png|left|thumb|Rupings carrying riders]]
Rupings were well-trained flying reptavians who were close to their owners and were very useful to the Onderon rebels. They had orange skin and four green eyes.

==Behind the scenes==
These creatures were named after ''The Clone Wars'' concept artist [[Tara Rueping]].<ref name="TCWEG">''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: Episode Guide]]''</ref>
